verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data. It exposes a Create-Dashboard tool that creates a new dashboard with text cards and reports, and agents can query events, funnels, retention and more in natural language, which covers the end-to-end agent-built dashboard flow. missing for 10: detailed docs on how the agent defines and creates the underlying metric reports for dashboard cards, documented REST API endpoints for dashboard creation (the Query API shown only returns computed results), independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-built dashboards.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
Create-Dashboard | Create a new dashboard with text cards and reports
you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
